environment: Node VM, production engine and content. Not student research or browser layout QA.

cases.name: Every new chapter models every question family it can test; no untaught family in practice or chapter exam
Regression: P3 first fraction lesson only represents fractions; comparison and addition are explicitly taught in lesson 2
Meaningful calculation traces: borrowing across zero and carrying, rather than only final answer
Original school-format examples use correct independent arithmetic and non-empty figures
Decimal word answers are displayed as decimals; P3 fractions keep the taught denominator
Empty practice checks preserve both question and first-attempt record
Existing submitted answers remain immutable and historical template IDs still regenerate
Fraction division reasoning and numeric figures use valid equal units
Every active chapter template figure has finite output for representative seeds
